verdict.rationale: OCI documents a Free Trial of $300 in credits valid for up to 30 days, plus a set of Always Free offers that never expire and stay available after the trial ends. Community users confirm running Always Free ARM instances (4 vCPU / 24 GiB, 10TB bandwidth) for years at no cost. Several users report idle-resource reclamation after 7 days of low utilization; this is a usage caveat, not a contradiction of the free tier. Missing for 10: first-party evidence spelling out the per-resource Always Free limits, documented idle-reclamation and utilization rules, and any published startup-credits program.
